title: engram control refuses the --actor-context its host passes, so no turn has been mediated since 2026-09-03
outcome: A host that passes one execution context to every Engram channel of a session can start the control connection: engram control accepts --actor-context (and ENGRAM_ACTOR_CONTEXT), records it on its attribution as the work words do, and turn-gated mediation works again once that build is installed.
acceptance: after the fixed build is installed and TermAl restarted, a turn-gated project's store shows a new control session and turn grant
engram control started with TermAl's exact argument order (--actor-id, --actor-context, --session-id) serves instead of exiting 2; the control dogfood spawns it that way and passes
the control connection's records carry the normalized actor context as provenance; host_control_attributes_its_records_to_the_supplied_actor_context passes
